scientific_integrity: Spectral and isomorphism classifications proved analytically; a standalone program checks all small projector differences and numerical crossing. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic linear unweighted connected simple undirected graph consensus; fixed unit impulse and squared Euclidean error. No claim about quantum vdP systems, weighted graphs, or all larger graph types; independent historical priority not established.
title: The bull graph is the smallest network with a reversal of localized consensus relaxation
